entries.what: Early morning walk on the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk for her back, then breakfast and getting DeShawn out the door. Sat down at the kitchen table with the paper calendar to plan Thanksgiving for 14 at Alder Court.
entries.outcome: Worked out a rough menu under $120 and decided which sides relatives will be told to bring.

entries.what: MWF 9 a.m. anatomy with Dr. Okoye, sitting next to Linh; ate packed leftovers from the blue cooler bag in the car in Lot C afterward.
entries.outcome: Took notes on the nervous system unit and marked the brachial plexus as the thing to cram.

entries.what: Priced Thanksgiving turkey and ham at Ruiz Family Market and picked up meat for Sunday batch cooking. Evening at the kitchen table after 9 p.m. with index cards.
entries.outcome: Bought the meat and finished two body-system card sets.

entries.what: Veterans Day: college closed. Slept a little later, then drove her mother-in-law Loretta to a checkup and the pharmacy since the day was free of class.
entries.outcome: Loretta's errands done early; Rochelle used the holiday for catch-up reading afterward.

entries.what: Andre worked his 10-hour yard shift, so Rochelle handled dinner and DeShawn's homework check. Folded laundry with the old hospital drama on.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening; Andre fell asleep early after his long day.

entries.what: Wednesday anatomy lecture and lab with Okoye. During the break she started a text telling Keisha she couldn't help move a couch Saturday, then deleted it.
entries.outcome: Didn't send it; decided to figure out how to fit the couch in somehow.

entries.what: Sat in the car in Lot C with only 40 minutes before the next thing and asked her assistant how to cram the brachial plexus for the lab.
entries.outcome: Got a short memorization trick and ran through it twice on index cards.

entries.what: Evening kitchen-table study after dinner, with Keisha calling about the couch.
entries.outcome: Agreed to help with the couch for an hour and lost study time.

entries.what: First fall storm: heavy rain on the drive to Tamsen Valley, with flooding on Ruel Road and slow traffic. Skipped the marsh walk because the boardwalk was slick. Intro Chemistry at 11.
entries.outcome: Arrived late but made chem; parked in a wet Lot C.

entries.what: Afternoon at home in the rain doing medical terminology online module and chem problems while Andre texted about slow yard trucks.
entries.outcome: Finished the module before the deadline.

entries.what: Rain continued. Between classes she asked her assistant for the answer on a nerve question and cut off its encouraging intro with 'I know I can do it, what's the answer'.
entries.outcome: Got the direct answer and moved on.

entries.what: Anatomy lecture with Okoye and Linh, then lunch in the car in Lot C. Keisha called on her 10 a.m. dispatch break.
entries.outcome: Kept the call short and went back to class.

entries.what: Cooked a quick dinner and checked DeShawn's homework while Andre got home late from the yard after the storm.
entries.outcome: Family ate together, then she studied cards at the table.

entries.what: Saturday morning helped Keisha move the couch with Andre's help, back sore afterward.
entries.outcome: Couch moved; her back flared and she rested with a heating pad.

entries.what: Afternoon at the discount warehouse store for bulk Thanksgiving items, counting each price against line hours.
entries.outcome: Stayed under budget for the bulk items.

entries.what: Evening review of anatomy cards while Aaliyah got ready for her Ridgeline night shift.
entries.outcome: Aaliyah borrowed her flashcards for a quick look before leaving.

entries.what: Sunday batch cooking: red beans and rice for the week. Skipped the 11 a.m. Baptist service for errands and cooking.
Andre watched football and fell asleep by the second half; Aaliyah was at her rec soccer game in the morning.
entries.outcome: Rochelle used the quiet to study at the kitchen table.

entries.what: Wrote the week's schedule on the fridge calendar in color pens for each person.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out, with Tuesday study time penciled in.
